$schema: Layer 0 bootstrap configuration - the packaged defaults. Every key is optional and these values are the ones compiled into the application, so a server with no configuration package behaves exactly as this file describes. To change one, contribute a bootstrap fragment from your own configuration package; it is applied after this one and wins key by key. Do not edit this file on a server: it is inside the nuxeo-agentic-core bundle, which every upgrade replaces.
$public: Served without authentication at /nuxeo/agentic-ui-config/bootstrap.json, because the application reads it before sign-in. Put nothing secret in a bootstrap fragment.
$nuxeoApiOrigin: Origin for Nuxeo REST calls. Leave empty for same-origin deployments.
$nuxeoServerUrl: Nuxeo as seen by external clients such as Nuxeo Drive. null derives it from the browser location.
$themes: Merged over the packaged themes by id. 'tokens' are CSS custom properties applied to <html> while the theme is active, so a rebrand needs no rebuild. Add an entry with a new id to add a whole theme.
$availableLanguages: Only the languages with a catalogue in apps/nuxeo-ui/public/i18n/. The target set is Nuxeo Web UI's ten (ar nl en fr de he it ja es sv), so th and zh were dropped; ar, es, he, it and sv are registered and requested from Crowdin but cannot be advertised until their catalogues arrive, because checkAdvertisedLocalesShip fails a language that would render the English fallback throughout. See D8e-webui in docs/i18n-localization-plan.md.
